text: khattiyasuttaṃ [30] ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi khattiyo dipadaṃ 1 seṭṭho balibaddho 2 catuppadaṃ komārī 3 seṭṭhā bhariyānaṃ yo ca puttāna pubbajoti . [31] sambuddho dipadaṃ seṭṭho ājānīyo catuppadaṃ sussūsā seṭṭhā bhariyānaṃ yo ca puttānamassavoti 4 . pañcamaṃ
